## About
Lakeway Plumbing Company is a local, family owned business. Erick Kuehn earned his journeyman's license, worked for other Austin area plumbing companies, then earned his Master's plumbing license and started the business that became Lakeway Plumbing Company. He is licensed with the state of Texas as a Responsible Master Plumber and manages most of the day to day work himself.
His wife Amie helps part time with billing and marketing. Together with their son Mason, they live the Lake Austin lifestyle, and on their rare days off you will find them boating, kayaking, swimming or out at an Austin festival.
We take care of each customer the way we would want to be treated, and we aim to offer a valued service at a fair and honest price. Homeowners and businesses have given us a 4.2 rating across 72 Google reviews.

## Services
- Sink, faucet and toilet repair: Installations and repairs for sinks, faucets and toilets.
- Kitchen and bathroom updates: Updates and repairs for kitchens and bathrooms.
- Sewer installations and repairs: New sewer installations and repairs to existing ones.
- Old or leaking water lines: We take care of old, slow running or leaking interior water lines.
- Gas and mechanical piping: Gas and mechanical piping for homes and commercial buildings.
- Bar and restaurant fixtures: Fixtures for bars and restaurants to help keep your business running.
- Water filter systems: Installation of water filter systems.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We serve the greater Austin area, including Lakeway, Bee Cave, Austin, Westlake, West Austin, Spicewood and Leander.

Q: Do you work with businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We are a residential and commercial plumbing company.

Q: Can you help in the evening or on a weekend?
A: We understand plumbing problems don't keep business hours. We offer some evening and weekend services, so give us a call.

Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes. Erick Kuehn is a fully insured Responsible Master Plumber.
